convo.title: Inbox
convo.intro: Customer messages and the replies waiting for you.
convo.emptyHint: When a customer writes to your Instagram account, the conversation appears here.
convo.selectHint: Select a conversation to view details, messages, and reply drafts.
convo.humanMode: You are handling this conversation. The assistant does not draft replies until you hand it back.
convo.eraseTooltip: Permanently erase customer conversation records (Owner only)
convo.eraseConfirm: Are you sure you want to permanently erase all messages and customer memory for this conversation? This cannot be undone.

window.closedHint: Instagram allows replies only within 24 hours of the customer’s last message. You can reply again once they write.

draft.youMustReply: This message needs your own answer.
draft.unconfirmed: We could not confirm that this was sent. Please check Instagram.
draft.waitingForOwner: An owner or manager has to approve this reply.

composer.label: Your reply
composer.warning: “{{text}}” is not a verified value from your business information.
composer.warningVerified: “{{text}}” matches your verified information, but is typed by hand.

reason.CONTAINS_PRICING: Contains a price, so the pricing setting applies
reason.CONTAINS_HOURS: Contains opening hours, so the hours setting applies
reason.CONTAINS_LOCATION_CONTACT: Contains an address or contact detail, so the address and contact setting applies
reason.CONTAINS_SERVICES: Contains service details, so the services setting applies
reason.CONTAINS_BOOKING: Contains booking details, so the booking setting applies
reason.CONTAINS_PROMOTIONS: Contains a promotion, so the promotions setting applies
reason.CONTAINS_GENERAL_FAQ: Contains a common-question answer, so the general questions setting applies
reason.AUTOMATION_OFF: Automation is off for this topic
reason.ESCALATION_KEYWORD: Contains one of your hand-over words
reason.INJECTION_SUSPECTED: Looks like an attempt to give the assistant instructions

convo.emptyFilterHint: No conversation matches this filter right now.
convo.commentsEmptyHint: Public comments on your posts appear here.

sectionIntro.messages: Customer messages and the replies waiting for you.
sectionIntro.comments: Public comments on your posts and how the assistant handles them.
sectionIntro.questions: Information the assistant needs from you to answer customers.

messages.title: Select a conversation
messages.hint: Open a conversation to read the messages, review the assistant’s draft and reply.

comments.title: Select a comment
comments.hint: Open a comment to see the post, the thread and what the assistant did.

questions.title: Select a question
questions.hint: Open a question to answer it. Your answer helps the assistant reply to customers.

legend.needs_approval: The assistant prepared a reply. Review it, then approve, edit or reject.
legend.needs_human: The assistant left this to you, for example a complaint. Write your own reply.
legend.failed: A reply could not be sent. Open the conversation to see what happened.

automation.title: Automation
automation.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
automation.policies: What the assistant may do alone
automation.intro: By default every reply waits for your approval. Turn on automatic sending per topic once you trust it.
automation.autoNeedsReady: Automatic sending becomes available when your business information is complete and an account is connected.
automation.reviewHint: Saving does not count as a review. Confirm once you have looked at the settings above; it is the last setup step.

answers.title: Approved answers
answers.staffNote: Only owners and managers can create or archive approved answers.
answers.intro: Replies you approved once and want reused. Prices, hours and contacts are written as placeholders so they always follow your verified information.
answers.templateHint: Use a placeholder for values, for example {{example}}. Never type a price or phone number.
answers.literalValue: The answer contains a price, time, contact or link typed by hand. Replace it with a placeholder.

devPanel.title: Developer tools
devPanel.intro: Simulate customers and failures. Everything here is labelled as simulated.
devPanel.publishedHint: Posts that were really published to the fake Instagram. Each content item must appear exactly once.
devPanel.publishedNone: Nothing has been published in the simulator yet.
devPanel.healthCheckHint: Tries the unstable accounts now; if Instagram answers again the account becomes connected and waiting replies are sent.

reset.title: Reset the demo
reset.hint: Deletes this demo workspace and creates it again from the seed data, with yesterday's history. The workspace gets a new id.
reset.confirmBody: Everything in this workspace is deleted and recreated from the seed data: conversations, content, drafts and settings you changed. Other workspaces are not touched.
